about: The postcommunio of the formulary “3rd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the holy things of which we have partaken bring us to life and prepare for Your everlasting mercy those whom You have cleansed from sin. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
